proposals_detail.text: To address your need for a RAG‑powered support assistant that integrates pgvector, FastAPI and XGBoost, I can deliver a production‑ready solution within two weeks. I recently built a similar RAG support assistant for a SaaS company, using LangChain, FastAPI, pgvector, which resolved 62% of tier‑1 tickets without escalation [cs-ai_ml-rag_support]. The core module was implemented with PGVector and LangChain and is available in a dedicated repository [code-ai_ml-rag_support]. My CV confirms extensive experience with FastAPI, RAG, pgvector and XGBoost, as demonstrated across multiple projects [cv-ai_ml]. I will provide a fully functional API, comprehensive documentation, and a handover call to ensure smooth adoption. The proposed fixed price of $2,387 aligns with the two‑week timeline and covers development, testing, and knowledge transfer.

I understand you need a reliable fitness tracking mobile app built with Expo, Firebase, React Native, and WebSockets to support your users' activity data. I recently delivered a fitness tracking mobile app for a fitness company, designing and building the solution with React Native and Firebase, and deploying it on both iOS and Android platforms [cs-fullstack-mobile]. The app includes real‑time data sync via WebSockets, ensuring users see live updates of their workouts, a capability I also implemented in a real‑time team chat project [cs-fullstack-chat]. At $40 per hour, the proposed fixed price of $2,288 aligns with the project scope and timeline, delivering a high‑quality product within your budget.

I understand you need a reliable shipment ETL pipeline built with Airflow, PostgreSQL, and visualized in Looker Studio. I recently delivered a shipment ETL pipeline for a logistics company, designing and building the solution using Airflow, Python, and PostgreSQL, which automated 14 daily data feeds with 99.7% on‑time performance [cs-data_analyst-etl]. In addition, I have created Looker Studio dashboards that translate complex data into actionable insights, as demonstrated in a recent GA4 analytics implementation [rv-data_analyst-ga4]. My hourly rate is $35, and I propose a fixed price of $2002 to complete the work within the four‑week timeline, covering development, testing, documentation, and a final handover call.
